new_scholarship.description: Malmö University awards a limited number of merit-based tuition-fee scholarships each year to master's students from outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland who are required to pay tuition fees. The scholarships cover partial or up to the full tuition fee for an English-taught master's programme but do not cover living expenses. Students apply through University Admissions in the first admissions round, and admitted applicants receive scholarship application instructions after Notification of Selection Results. Offers are notified by the end of April, and the tuition fee payment deadline is 10 May.

programme_detail_official.description: Malmö University offers a limited number of scholarships to qualified master students from outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland who are required to pay tuition fees. They are awarded on the basis of academic merit, experience and motivation, and cover partial or up to the full tuition fee but not other expenses such as living expenses. Applicants must apply in the first admissions round, choose an English-taught master's programme as first choice and be admitted to it; admitted students then receive instructions for the scholarship application and offers are notified by the end of April.
programme_detail_official.coverage: Tuition fees only (partial or up to full); no living-cost or travel coverage.

Plan financing for living costs and housing in Malmö, because the scholarship does not cover them

Not being admitted to the first-choice programme
Being from the EU/EEA or Switzerland and therefore not being required to pay tuition fees
Applying to a programme that is not taught in English

alerts.message: Scholarship application instructions are sent to admitted students after Notification of Selection Results. If you are admitted in the first round and nothing arrives, contact tuitionfees@mau.se.
For autumn 2027 the first University Admissions round opens 16 October 2026 and closes 15 January 2027. Missing the first round makes you ineligible for this scholarship.
Malmö University states that applicants not offered a scholarship are not notified individually, so silence is not a rejection signal.

submission_workflow: Choose an English-taught master's programme at Malmö University and note its first-round deadline.
Submit the University Admissions application with the Malmö programme ranked first and pay the application fee.
Submit the required supporting documents by the University Admissions documentation deadline.
Await Notification of Selection Results and the scholarship application instructions.
Complete and submit the scholarship application before the stated deadline in the instructions.
If awarded, accept the scholarship within the timeframe given and pay tuition fees by the invoice deadline (first instalment 10 May for newly admitted students).

legacy_titles: Lund University African Research Universities Alliance (ARUA) Scholarship
new_scholarship.deadline: The scholarship application round "usually opens in early February every year" and applicants "will not be able to apply until you have received the email with the link to the scholarship application portal in February." The related study application deadline is "15 January" with the application fee and supporting documents due "in early February". No exact calendar date is published for the scholarship round.

new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: Students who are or have been enrolled at one of the listed ARUA member universities in 19 African countries, hold citizenship of a country outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland, are required to pay Lund tuition fees, and have submitted a correct, complete and timely Lund application with Lund as first choice.

Have submitted a correct, complete and timely application for an international degree programme at Lund University
Have selected Lund University as first choice on universityadmissions.se
coverage: Up to 90% of tuition fees, depending on the available budget of the programme/faculty
Living costs are explicitly not covered
benefits: Tuition fee waiver of up to a maximum of 90% of tuition fees
new_scholarship.duration: Follows the degree programme the applicant is awarded for; the page does not publish a fixed award duration.
new_scholarship.program_type: University tuition-fee scholarship (merit-based, restricted to ARUA member-university students)

new_scholarship.selection_notes: The scholarship is merit-based only, so "your financial situation/challenges are not considered in the selection process". Priority is given to students with strong academic performance who are judged a good fit for the programme, show strong commitment to Lund University, and ranked Lund first. The ARUA result is sent in the same email as the Lund University Global Scholarship result.

Applicants may apply for the Lund University Global Scholarship and Swedish Institute scholarships in addition, but only one ARUA Scholarship per application round.
new_scholarship.description: Lund University runs the ARUA Scholarship as part of its global scholarship programme for high-achieving African students who have demonstrated academic excellence at an ARUA member university. The award is selective and merit-based and covers a percentage of tuition fees up to a maximum of 90%, depending on the budget of the programme or faculty concerned; living costs are not covered. Applicants must first apply for an international degree programme at Lund University with Lund as first choice, then apply through a separate Lund scholarship portal that opens by email invitation in early February each year.

programme_detail_official.description: The ARUA Scholarship is part of Lund University's global scholarship programme and provides financial support to prospective students who have demonstrated academic excellence at an ARUA member university in Africa. It is selective and merit-based, aimed at African students committed to Lund University. The award covers a percentage of tuition fees up to a maximum of 90%, with the exact percentage dependent on the budget of the relevant programme or faculty, and it does not cover living costs. Applicants must apply for an international degree programme with Lund as first choice and then apply through a separate scholarship portal that opens by email in early February each year, including a one-minute motivation video.
programme_detail_official.coverage: Up to 90% of tuition fees for students from ARUA member universities; living costs and travel are not covered.

application_readiness_checklist: Confirm you are or have been a student at an ARUA member university listed on the Lund ARUA page (check arua.org for the current member list)
Apply for an international degree programme at Lund University on universityadmissions.se with Lund as first choice
Pay the application fee and submit all supporting documents in early February
Watch your Lund email for the scholarship application portal link in February
Record a personal scholarship motivation video of maximum 1 minute and host it on YouTube, Vimeo or a similar open-source platform
Focus the video on academic achievement and why Lund fits your goals - not on financial need
Plan how you will cover living costs, because the scholarship does not
common_rejection_risks: Lund not ranked first choice in the universityadmissions.se application
Not being from an ARUA member university, which the page says makes the application invalid
Missing the early-February scholarship round because the portal link had not been requested or checked
Uploading a motivation video longer than 1 minute or not on an open-source video platform
Presenting financial hardship in the motivation video, which the page rules out because selection is merit-based only
Expecting the scholarship to cover living costs
estimated_uncovered_costs: Living costs - explicitly excluded; recipients must meet the Swedish Migration Agency financial support requirement themselves
The remaining tuition fee above the awarded percentage, which may be less than the full 90%
Books, course materials and study-related travel
document_audit: universityadmissions.se application showing Lund as first choice
Admission application supporting documents submitted by the early-February deadline
Scholarship motivation video link, maximum 1 minute, on an open-source platform

alerts.message: The Lund scholarship portal link is emailed only to applicants who applied for an international degree programme at Lund with Lund as first choice. Check spam and the international admissions inbox from early February.
The award covers 'a percentage of the tuition fees, up to a maximum of 90%' and depends on the budget of the programme or faculty, so the awarded percentage may be lower.
Lund notes that the list on its page 'may not reflect the latest changes' and directs applicants to the ARUA website for the current member universities.

submission_workflow: Verify your ARUA member-university eligibility and non-EU/EEA citizenship status.
Choose and apply for an international degree programme at Lund University through universityadmissions.se, ranking Lund first.
Pay the application fee and upload supporting documents by the early-February documentation deadline.
Await the February email with the link to the Lund University scholarship application portal.
Record and upload the one-minute motivation video, then complete the scholarship application form with the video link.
Await the result, which arrives by email together with the Lund University Global Scholarship result after admission results are announced.
